_comment: EXPLICIT resolution map: a roster CANONICAL key (the org/repo in rosters.json) -> the ACTUAL on-disk LM Studio repo(s) (publisher/repo under ~/.lmstudio/models) holding this model's weights. Replaces resolveGguf's fuzzy publisher-blind match, which mis-resolved when a model exists under several publishers at different quants. USUALLY one repo; TWO when q4 and f16 live under different publishers (glm-4.7-flash, qwen3-14b have bartowski bf16 + a separate q4 repo). resolveGguf gathers ggufs from ALL listed repos and picks the target quant: q4 = the WORKHORSE (default); fp16 = best-effort REFERENCE — where no f16 exists locally it ladders DOWN (q8 last resort). An unmapped key falls back to the fuzzy match.
